creativeThesis: An ordinary-looking open trap can carry a short history of what touched it; the history persists as a fading chemical response.
viewerExperience: See a living hair move → realize an internal signal occurred → follow a lingering calcium state → compare another signal before and after decay → distinguish signals from touch count → understand biochemical memory.
emotionalTarget: Living wonder followed by an intuitive, scientifically qualified understanding of temporal information.
visualThesis: The same leaf’s interior state changes with time; a spatially connected macro-to-tissue reveal makes persistence and accumulation felt without a permanent chart.

decisions.treatment: Original botanical macro scene with spatially connected qualitative tissue cutaway
decisions.rationale: Connect tissue response to the hair that was actually moved; original spatial illustration allows consistent separate trials while actual experiment footage remains an alternative. All reconstructions/tints are disclosed.
alternativesConsidered: Original botanical macro scene with spatially connected qualitative tissue cutaway
Real recorded trap experiment with original calcium illustration integrated over the footage
Microscopy and evidence discovery as the organizing story
Flat temporal diagram of two signal histories

decisions.treatment: Natural green outer lobes and muted reddish interiors under soft daylight with close surface detail and sparse environmental depth. The tissue view is a clearly illustrative continuation of that leaf, not a literal micrograph. Warm internal activity tint is qualitative and labeled; no neon electricity, toothy monster, lab-dashboard panels or code-derived default black field.
decisions.rationale: Use morphology and temporal change to carry fascination. Palette follows real plant anatomy and readable separation, not a science category or forced opposition to previous walnut/blue masters.

decisions.treatment: Kokoro af_heart remains primary. Curious, warm opening; observational hair event; unhurried fade/accumulation; clear emphasis on signals versus touches; settle functional memory definition. No audio generated.
decisions.rationale: Voice continuity is explicit brand policy; a biology subject does not justify auditions. No theatrical horror or claims of plant consciousness.

decisions.treatment: Designed burned-in speech-first phrase captions remain mandatory in future production; propose readable mixed-case typography with sparse emphasis and placement chosen around the hair and calcium state. Short illustration/time-compression disclosures remain legible. Exact font sizing/cues/safe bounds are unprepared.
decisions.rationale: Captions preserve may/can/soon enough and the definition, never shorten scientific meaning or label two physical contacts as universal. They must not obstruct the evidence being explained.

decisions.treatment: Propose quiet natural-room/garden texture only where helpful and restrained illustrative hair/snap cues. Compare voice with sparse cues against voice-only during later authorized audio review; no mandatory music bed or literal electrical spark sound.
decisions.rationale: Support physical context and let the biochemical change breathe. The internal calcium scene is a representation, not a microphone recording of cellular events. No sounds or audio generated.

decisions.treatment: 116 words; speech-only 43.5–48 seconds at145–160words/min, plus4–8seconds for visual recognition gives 47.5–56 seconds. No preset length or monetization padding.
decisions.rationale: Two timings and the single-movement exception must be comprehensible; choose the shortest actual duration that preserves that payoff after authorization. No equality of scene lengths or forced fast cuts.

decisions.treatment: A Venus flytrap has no brain. Yet a touch can leave a fading memory.
decisions.rationale: Direct brain-free memory establishes why the viewer may care; observational macro immediately grounds it. Three materially different truthful openings compared before selecting; exact recommended script has no greeting, logo lead-in or spokenCTA.

decisions.treatment: Conceptual vertical short with large leaf/hair states and readable phrase captions, no split-screen dashboard. Platform profiles, covers, native/device geometry and publication copy remain unprepared.
decisions.rationale: Current scope is creative review only. No canvas, safe-area or thumbnail assertion without actual media/device evidence.

portfolioReview.selectionRationale: Four latest available exact approved/locked masters by recorded decision time: DiceV4,DevilsHoleV2,FLIPV1,VermeerV2. No popularity/publication/domain filter.
portfolioReview.proposedFeedImpression: Living botanical material and temporal information, with familiar readable speech. Changing organic state takes precedence over interchangeable diagram cards.
portfolioReview.toolingBiasCheck: Compared macro/cutaway, recorded experiment, microscopy-first evidence story and flat temporal model. Existing rendering primitives confer no creative preference.

ownerReview.rationale: Owner explicitly requests Cycle15 Creative Review and withholds audio generation/master rendering/publication preparation. Internal source verification is not owner narration or creative approval.

risks: Anatomy/movement consistency in a proposed original macro treatment is untested; no actual plant experiment or convincing-motion render exists.
Threshold representation is qualitative and probabilistic, not a calibrated universal switch.
Cutaway cannot imply identified memory cells, naturally luminous calcium, nerve anatomy, hydraulic motor or resolved molecular bridge.
Separate trials and return to earlier example must be explicit to avoid impossible instant reopening.
Source paper figures/videos have no production license here; exact original asset/font/audio provenance remains downstream.
Actual narration duration, intelligibility, seamless motion, rendered comprehension, device safety and native feed impression remain untested.

provenance.notes: Manual session primary/review inspection, exact evidence reconciliation, hook/narration/treatment comparison and actual read-only six-image portfolio inspection. No provider envelope/usage fabricated, no paidcall, generated media, audio or render.
